events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: Known for his distinctive vocals and outspoken personality, William John Paul Gallagher was born on September 21, 1972, in Manchester.

angles.name: Rock 'n' Roll Star
angles.copy: Happy 54th to the iconic Liam Gallagher! What's your favourite Oasis track that he fronted, or a standout moment from his solo career?

events.title: John Lennon's 'Imagine' album anniversary
events.blurb: John Lennon's iconic 'Imagine' album, released in the UK on October 8, 1971, continues to inspire with its powerful message of peace and unity.

angles.name: Imagine Peace
angles.copy: Fifty-five years since John Lennon asked us to 'Imagine'. What does this timeless anthem mean to you?

events.title: First iPod unveiled anniversary
events.blurb: Apple unveiled the original iPod on October 23, 2001, promising '1,000 songs in your pocket' and revolutionising how the world listened to music.

angles.name: Pocket Full of Tunes
angles.copy: Remember the first time you saw an iPod? Twenty-five years since Apple changed music forever. How many songs did you cram onto yours?

events.title: James Bond Day
events.blurb: James Bond Day celebrates the release of the very first 007 film, 'Dr. No', on October 5, 1962, marking over six decades of the iconic spy.

angles.name: Shaken Not Stirred
angles.copy: Happy James Bond Day! From iconic gadgets to legendary theme tunes, what's your favourite 007 moment?

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: Born on October 9, 1940, in Liverpool, John Lennon was a co-founder of The Beatles and an enduring icon of peace and music.

angles.name: Lennon's Legacy
angles.copy: Remembering John Lennon on what would have been his 86th birthday. His music and message continue to resonate globally.

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: English actor, comedian, and screenwriter John Cleese, famous for Monty Python and Fawlty Towers, was born on October 27, 1939.

angles.name: Comedy Legend
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 87th birthday to the brilliant John Cleese! What's your favourite Python sketch or Fawlty Towers moment?

events.title: The Beatles' 'White Album' anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles' self-titled double album, universally known as the 'White Album,' was originally released on November 22, 1968.

angles.name: White Album Wonder
angles.copy: Fifty-eight years since The Beatles delivered their sprawling 'White Album'. Which track from this double LP stands out for you?

events.title: Anniversary of Freddie Mercury's death
events.blurb: Freddie Mercury, the iconic frontman of Queen, passed away on November 24, 1991, leaving behind an unparalleled musical legacy.

angles.name: Legendary Performer
angles.copy: Remembering the one and only Freddie Mercury, 35 years since we lost a true showman. His voice and stage presence remain unmatched.

events.title: The Beatles' 'Rubber Soul' anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their groundbreaking album 'Rubber Soul' on December 3, 1965, marking a pivotal moment in their artistic evolution.

angles.name: Rubber Soul Revolution
angles.copy: Sixty-one years ago, The Beatles dropped 'Rubber Soul'. Did this album change how you heard music?

events.title: Anniversary of John Lennon's death
events.blurb: On December 8, 1980, the world mourned the tragic death of John Lennon in New York City, ending the life of a music legend and peace activist.

angles.name: Remembering Lennon
angles.copy: Forty-six years since we lost John Lennon. His vision for a better world, expressed through his music, lives on.
